notes.title: A Stellar Proclamation to the Ark of Trisolar Pioneers
notes.notes:
[p][b]A Stellar Proclamation to the Ark of Trisolar Pioneers[/b]
Dear Cosmic Voyagers,[/p][p]I am [b]Kellen[/b], your guide through the celestial tapestry. As these words shimmer across your visor, I stand before the frost-kissed viewport of the Ark's command deck, watching 42 planets waltz in the void's embrace. Welcome to this odyssey measured in light-years—every grain of alien dust beneath your boots inscribes a new stanza in humanity's epic.[/p][p]If you have any questions or good suggestions, please feel free to raise them here, and I will consider them as appropriate. So that everyone can better explore the planet. Ark of Trisolar has 42 planets that require leaving the surface of the Ark to reach. In the open world map, there are spaceships to assist players.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684731/02d975bbcbbbf544a9ca838fc0ad509659e8c3b0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🪐 42 Planets: Cosmic Psalms of Splendor and Peril[/b][/p][p]These 42 jewels forgotten by the universe are paradoxes penned by the Creator's hand:[/p][p][b]Aurora Crystal Prime[/b] (AOT-07): Megatons of crystal forests burst with sapphire coronas, their melodies soothing fractured souls—yet harmonic shards pierce hulls like paper;[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684731/6ea20ad7a266ec0676980efc061215e85f3dcf71.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Crimson Swampland[/b] (AOT-19): Islands of tungsten drift upon molten iron seas, their core-shrinking singularities thirsting for the warmth of your palms;[/p][p][b]Eternal Frostgrave[/b] (AOT-31): Ancient cities sleep in abyssal ice, their radioactive auroras awakening when you breach the frost, spearing darkness for 3,000 kilometers.[/p][p][b]To touch these forbidden fruits, you must first traverse the Ark's steel womb[/b]—as you stand at Launch Pad Delta-42, silver ravens emblazoned with [b]Trinity Sigils[/b] await in the fractures of the open world.[/p][p][b]☄️ Survival Sonnets for Starfarers[/b][/p][list][*][p]A [b]Quantum Compass[/b] pressed into your palm upon boarding—its needle bleeds the Ark's gravitational tears, a lifeline when the void claims your path(Long press the 'F' key in the game to explore);[/p][/*][*][p]Flee when violet crevices yawn beneath you on [b]Shatterfield[/b] (AOT-29)! The spacetime eyes within drink your fleeting years;[/p][/*][*][p]Heard whispers in the [b]Void Corridor[/b] (AOT-13)? Pour antimatter fuel into the compass—entropic shrieks shall scatter shadow specters.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][b]Remember: The fairest stars compose epitaphs with poisoned honey, and truth smiles only upon the gloriously mad.[/b]
— Kellen, By the Stargazer's Viewport[/p][/quote]
